title: Real NPC cargo, routes and resource telemetry
status: Explicit user implementation requirement; pending integrated runtime and display validation
request: Replace cargo/route placeholders with available NPC data and add tracked NPC shield, laser-heat and fuel values so targeting information reports actual readings.
verified_gap: On the gameplay integration branch, NPCState already carries ordinaryCargo, origin and destination, but TargetingComputer.information(for:) still returns unconditional Cargo Unavailable and Origin/Destination Unknown. Shield, laser-heat and fuel values have no authoritative per-NPC current state at this boundary; adding labels alone is insufficient.
display_rules: Pirate and Military modules display the selected NPC's actual ordinary cargo manifest and origin/destination. Known empty cargo is None; missing/unknown state is Unknown. Preserve each commodity's native tonne/kg/g units and exclude mission-reserved custody from ordinary loot display.

Resolve SystemIdentity using its own galaxy and valid system/special-PLUGH identity. Show the galaxy when needed. Preserve provenance: values defaulted while adopting legacy bodies are inferred/local or unknown, not evidence of a real interstellar itinerary.

Military displays current front/rear shield charge and effective capacity, actual laser heat and actual fuel amount/capacity. Use per-actor tracked state and consistent units, not commander resources, NPC hull maximum alone, energy-as-shield or cooldown-as-heat.
Keep existing actual missile count and actor-owned ECM active/equipped fields. Resolve actual catalogue-backed model/preview identity consistently, preserving explicit mission name/model overrides.

Treat attitude and legal record as distinct data. Identification-level status may disclose a clearly labelled legal state when approved by G1; never infer criminality from hostile-to-player or substitute commander.legal.
Station, asteroid, loose cargo and wreck metadata follows its proper target type and installed Mining/Salvage disclosure gates. Do not show fabricated generic ship telemetry for debris.

Keep the target panel bounded and readable at compact/full-screen sizes with fixed small fonts. Long manifests/routes must remain inspectable without clipping, overlap or leaking higher-tier information.
runtime_requirements: GameRuntime owns an authoritative per-NPC resource record, with current/max front/rear shields, shield recharge parameters, laser heat/cooling, and fuel/capacity. Initialize from the actual spawned hull/catalogue/role/equipment or explicit mission resource profile, and validate finite bounds.

Update these values through actual NPC laser firing/heat limits/cooling, attributed combat shield absorption/recharge and real fuel-consuming/refuelling actions. Do not invent fuel burn merely from ordinary acceleration if the game's fuel is a jump/scoop resource. Display snapshots reflect live state without mutating it.

Centralize damage/resource handling so rays/missiles/bombs/ECM and NPC-versus-NPC combat use the same resource authority and source attribution. Keep mission-specific shield/damage rules and difficulty/reward settlement explicit; generic NPC shields must not accidentally alter protected scripted encounters.

Persist resource/provenance state through save/load, culling/re-admission and retries as required by the scene/encounter model. Legacy bodies with absent telemetry use safe documented initialization or Unknown, never borrowed player values or silent full refills on repeated adoption.

New targeting snapshots carry NPC cargo/routes and optional resource facts. Pure formatting/resolution code can be separate from runtime ownership; incomplete resource support must be labelled unknown until real integration exists.

ownership.Elite Coder 1: Per-NPC resource/provenance schema, simulation/damage/firing/fuel/save initialization, target builder wiring, display gates/panel integration, docs and final acceptance. Sole owner of central shared files; coordinate mission-specific profiles with mission owner.
ownership.Elite Coder 3: Bounded new target telemetry formatting/resolution helper plus dedicated unit/regression tests, after G1 confirms concrete immutable API/file boundary. Start cargo/route/model facts from committed available NPC data; do not fake or implement central shield/heat/fuel runtime. Keep release verification readiness as a separate small task.
ownership.Elite Coder 2: Ensure encounter/mining/salvage producers populate accurate cargo/route/catalogue identity and provenance through agreed snapshots; no duplicate target UI or resource implementation.
ownership.Mission researcher: Natural-checkpoint compatibility review of protected actor shield/damage/fuel profiles and exactly-once event/custody persistence.

acceptance: Pirate/Military target a populated trader whose cargo/routes differ from player: exact NPC data appears and changes after real NPC collection/route actions; empty and absent manifests remain distinct.
Cross-galaxy, PLUGH, invalid IDs and legacy inferred route origins resolve honestly; missing state still uses Unknown. Model/preview match actual catalogue hull and mission override.
NPC takes front/rear damage, recharges, fires until heat limits/cools and uses/refills fuel: Military readings match actual simulation and snapshots, with no fake player/max/cooldown substitutions.
Lower modules cannot see higher-tier cargo/resource fields. Stations/debris/rocks/wrecks disclose appropriate type-specific data only under their own capability gates.
Save/load, cull/re-admit, failed-save/retry and protected mission combat preserve resources/provenance and cannot refill, duplicate rewards or leak mission cargo.

Compact/full-screen target panels and detailed docs show accurate inspectable facts. Run focused formatting/runtime/migration tests, native target-panel checks and final integrated make ci. Pure helper completion is not completion of this user requirement.
documentation: Update the targeting-computer guide, README/help and delivery backlog when the gameplay integration lands. Remove unconditional cargo/routes-unmodelled claims for the new runtime, describe actual tracked resource units and unknown cases, and preserve accurate pending/shipped/version distinction for the older released app.
release_boundary: Implement on the separate gameplay branch. Do not mutate the frozen 1.4 route release or claim this telemetry is included there.
